value.rationale: The Desargues graph is a canonical highly symmetric cubic bipartite graph, and the ordinary 3-cut complex is a recently introduced topological graph construction. The applicable general theorem leaves two possible homology degrees; determining that this natural 16-dimensional instance collapses to exactly 111 top spheres is a substantive exact boundary case rather than a routine invariant recomputation.
